profile.headline: Visual Analytics Developer at Quantivly
profile.summary: To apply my skills in Python, R, and statistics to challenges in data analytics and software development.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Building data visualization dashboards using Postgresql, Grafana, Javascript, and Plotly, and maintaining platforms with Docker Swarm.
positions.insights: Skills: PostgreSQL · JavaScript · Docker Swarm · Grafana · Bash

positions.title: PHD Student
positions.description: Worked on Structural Alert Discovery - Cross-referenced the Accelrys Metabolite Database and the ChEMBL database using Neo4j and analyzed molecules using graph theory and high performance computing in order to discover novel molecular substructures associated with adverse drug reactions.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer, Contract
positions.description: Worked on OpenStack-Helm, a component of the OpenStack ecosystem that provisions systems and deploys OpenStack on Kubernetes systems.
positions.insights: Skills: Python · Unit Testing · Git · Code Review

positions.title: Bioinformatics Developer, Contract
positions.description: Built Docker images and Python driver scripts, AWS Batch functions, AWS Lambda functions, and AWS State Machines for the Dev Cross bioinformatics pipeline for modular, scalable deployment. Worked to validate and troubleshoot the statistical methodology behind the Dev Cross bioinformatics pipeline.
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Python · NumPy · Unit Testing

positions.title: Senior Python Developer, Contract
positions.description: Performed bugfixes and added new functionality to Panera’s back-of-house system using PostgreSQL stored procedures, Python, and Javascript.
positions.insights: Skills: Python · Unit Testing · PostgreSQL · JavaScript · Git

positions.title: Bioinformatics Developer
positions.description: Built software and systems to support genomics research, including APIs and data visualization tools, using R, CSS, Javascript, and BASH. Developed software for, administered, and developed training for AWS migration for the Genomics and Data Science department.
positions.insights: Skills: R · CSS · JavaScript · Bash · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Senior Python Developer
positions.description: Worked with Python, MongoDB, and MeteorJS to develop an intelligent health management platform that monitors health metrics and gives users personalized feedback.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Collaborating with the Scientific and Statistical Computing Core of the NIMH Intramural Research Program, developers of AFNI, to add new functionality to the software and to develop 3D connectome analysis and visualization software.

positions.title: Science Intern
positions.description: Developed software for use in Neurological research, including task software designed to produce specific patterns of brain activity during the course of an MRI scan.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Performed a variety of tasks including recovering evidence for a live case by developing specialized forensic scripts, utilizing EnCase and developing scripts in EnScript, and developing a parallelized password cracking application for the Cell B.E. processor.

positions.title: Web Designer
positions.description: Designed the 2005 website for the local government’s “Bookmark in the Park” program to encourage reading, working extensively with the web design team and the “Bookmark in the Park” committee.

projects.title: Weird Tweets Finder (working title)
projects.description:
Created a tool that downloads tweets and analyzes them using a Markov model, Kolmogorov complexity, and other metrics to determine those that are the most statistically unlikely. 

Technologies: Python, Tweepy, Natural Language Toolkit (NLTK), MySQL, Windows 10 Ubuntu Subsystem

projects.title: Sumo Match Fixing Analysis
projects.description:
Reproduced Duggan and Levitt’s analysis of sumo scores in R. Tested data with OLS (linear probability model) and binomial GLM. Carried out computationally intensive analyses with cloud computing on Amazon EC2. 

Technologies: R, R Studio Server, Amazon EC2, Ubuntu Linux, Git

publications.title: Connectome Visualizer: a Brain Connectivity Visualizer for AFNI/SUMA
publications.publisher: 19th Annual Meeting of the Organization for Human Brain Mapping · Aug 1, 2012
